notes.title: Patch 2
notes.notes:
WARNING: These patch notes contain spoilers! 

Patch 1.2.2

Major changes:
- You can now hold SPACE BAR to move at half speed.
- Added invincibility by default after rainbow mode for all modes.
- Nerfed recharge rainbow mode ability significantly.
- Nerfed stat 5 rainbow mode in base game.
- Changed how !!! warning at end of special works. It will now appear when there is about 1 second left on your special, rather than appearing when your special bar is 3/4 empty. It will also reset when collecting new rainbow dots.
- Lowered timer significantly in insane mode to 110 seconds. 


Minor changes:
- Changed name of "Blue Dot Frenzy" to "Bonus Points Frenzy" for clarity.
- Replaced mention of "Special" with "Rainbow Mode" for consistency.
- Added hamburger to top left of main menu.
- "New Ability" sign now plays the "flash" animation on loop rather than just once.
- Adjusted graphics for rainbow mode tutorial.
